artifacts.digest_algorithm:
SHA-256 folded over every regular file in package-relative path-sorted order: for each file, update with hex(sha256(relative_path)) + '
' + hex(sha256(file_bytes)) + '
'; the final hex digest is the tree digest (tests/release-smoke.test.mjs, treeDigest). No metadata (mtimes, modes, inodes) enters the digest.
